objective: Create a todo titled 'Pay rent' using the new-todo input. Double-click the 'Pay rent' label to edit it. In the edit field, select all of its text and delete it (Ctrl+A, then Backspace) so the field is completely empty, and only then press Escape; then assert that the todo list no longer contains a todo titled 'Pay rent'.

runs.oneLiner: removed the “Pay rent” todo on the todo list

runs.app: React port after the mutation run’s fixes (commit 40f2c99)
runs.oneLiner: The check expected Escape to save an empty edit and remove the todo, but Escape cancels the edit and keeps the original todo.
runs.summary:
The test assumed that pressing Escape after clearing the edit field would delete the todo. In this todo interface, Escape is a cancel action, so the previous title, “Pay rent,” is restored instead.
Revise the scenario to commit the empty field with Enter or by moving focus away, then verify deletion. If the intended behavior is specifically that Escape deletes an empty edit, change the product requirement and add a dedicated test for it.
